items.headline: McKenzie throws for 2 TDs and former Syracuse commit MacCormack helps lead BC over Orange 27-15
items.description: — Mason McKenzie threw two touchdown passes, former Syracuse commit Bo MacCormack III broke up the middle for a 56-yard score and Boston College beat the Orange 27-15 on Saturday.

items.headline: No. 3 Notre Dame has no letdown after Miami win, routs Boston College 41-7
items.description: — CJ Carr passed for 217 yards and two touchdowns, and No. 3 Notre Dame showed no letdown after knocking off Miami last week, beating Boston College 41-7 on Saturday.
